$schema_note: Machine-readable PAI→WorkOS rename map. Single source of truth for the rename. Consumed by humans, rename tooling, AND privacy/scrub gates (ShadowRelease G1-G14, sync-docs, DenyListCheck) — a gate grepping for a token that no longer exists passes vacuously, so gates MUST read this map, never hardcode the old mark. See RenamePlan.md for narrative.

casing.rule: Prose/branding/UI always 'WorkOS'. 'WorkOs' only where the PascalCase file convention forces it (e.g. WorkOsThesis.md). 'Work OS' (spaced) is retired.

members: projects/ session dirs encoding old paths
MEMORY/WORK archived ISAs and analysis files
published blog URLs and the WorkOS Maturity Model in public content

transitional.policy: Shims kept exactly one release cycle after the cut, then retired

members.shim: GitHub repo redirect danielmiessler/PAI -> renamed repo
members.retire_after: GitHub-managed, persists until a new repo takes the old name (never create one)

target.policy: Says WorkOS now or at cut per class verdicts below

classes.name: context-block-tags
classes.procedure: Emitters, readers, the gate, AND the system prompt move in ONE change. Readers accept both prefixes for a migration window; emitters write only workos-*. A half-rename silently stops enforcing the 🧠 MEMORY line, because FormatGate ties that line to a SUBSTRING match on the delta tag.
classes.status: DONE 2026-07-29 (public issue #1592 / PR #1594, @anikinsasha) — emitters MemoryDeltaSurface/LoadMemory/MemoryTurnStart/PostToolObserver emit workos-* only; FormatGate.deltaThisTurn accepts both prefixes (TAG_PREFIXES); WORKOS_SYSTEM_PROMPT.md render contract names the new tags (tag identifiers only — no version bump, no semantic edit); Memory/Hooks/Architecture docs updated. Legacy pai- acceptance is droppable once no in-flight pai- transcripts remain.
